notes.title: Autumn Sale kick off + iOS version now available
notes.notes:
We are super happy to announce that after more than a year of development, ePic Character Generator is finally available in the App Store for iOS devices! If you've been waiting for support for iPhones and iPads, now the wait is finally over and you can get to enjoy generating characters on your Apple devices, using all the packages purchased on Steam!

While we expect most of the functionalities to work correctly, you might encounter bugs or crashes that we would love to fix. So if this is the case, please let us know, so we can look into the issue and fix it ASAP!

Also, starting today, we are holding our annual Autumn Sale lasting until 29 November. If you missed out on our Halloween Sale, you can now grab most of our packs and bundles for a 25% discount!

We have also recently celebrated crossing 1000 reviews on Steam, with an 83% Positive rating! We are very pleased to see so many people enjoying our tool.

notes.title: Mac version is now available!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that after several months of hard work, we’ve finally reached a state where we can release the Mac version of ePic Character Generator! We’ve been getting messages about a Mac version for years, but we never were at a stage where we could’ve considered porting it, so being able to roll it out now makes me really happy!

A huge thanks to arby for doing the heavy-lifting of porting the software and David for providing us constant feedback on the builds so we could fix issues early and hopefully provide a smooth experience! We don’t expect the port to be perfect, so if you face any issues, make sure to let us know so we can look into it!

If you’ve been waiting for the Mac version for a while, you can now get your hands on the software!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/408930
In order to take advantage of Steam's data-sharing system, I had to reconfigure the depots in Steamworks. I expect the Steam clients to be able to successfully download all the content and the changed executables, but if you are on Windows and facing issues, you can try the following:

1: Right-click ePic Character Generator in your Library
2: Select Properties
3: Under Local Files, select Verify integrity of software files

If there are any missing files, the client should download them for you. In case you are still having issues, simply Uninstall and Reinstall the software. If that doesn't work either make sure to reach out, so I know there is an issue that needs solving. :)

Also, starting today, we are celebrating the Lunar New Year with a Sale lasting until 3 February. If you missed out on our Winter sale, you can now grab most of our packs and bundles for a 25% discount!

notes.title: Android release and Halloween Sale
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we last posted an update regarding our software. First of all, we are very happy to announce that ePic Character Generator is finally available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.overheadgames.epicgenerator]Google Play[/url], so you can download it to your mobile to take with you! Generating images while travelling or updating your character real-time at your role-playing sessions have never been easier! The android version comes with the same features and interface as of the Standalone and Steam versions, so it'll be easy to pick up just where you left off. Also all of your packages will be available on all platforms, regardless of where you purchased them!

We are also happy to announce that we are participating in the Steam Halloween Sale where you can grab all our packs and bundles at a stunning 30% discount! 

As a gift of our gratitude for the long time support, we'll add the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/488993/ePic_Character_Generator__Season_2_Female_Halloween/]Season #2: Female Halloween[/url] pack to each account that holds at least one pack at the end of the sale. So if you don't already have the Halloween pack and been waiting for an opportunity to purchase your very first pack, now would be the best time to do so!

We also wanted to give you more ways of acquiring more packs for free, so for this reason we've added 4 brand new Achievements to the [url=https://www.epicgenerator.net/index.php/my-epic]Profile[/url] page! Make sure to check them and collect your free packs to exchange them as you like! While adding the new Achievements we've also checked if you've previously met the requirements for them, so you might already have a few free packs at your disposal.

We hope you like the updates this time, and as always we are happy to receive feedback both on our forums or in e-mail. Also if you encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know so we can fix them as soon as possible.

We are always on the lookout for new [url=https://www.epicgenerator.net/index.php/partners]Partners[/url]. Do you own a business, or know a site or place that could be interesting for our users? Let us know! Are you using the software to complement your own art, and would you be able to create packs on your own? Check out our [url=https://www.epicgenerator.net/index.php/developer-program]Developer's Guide[/url] and get creative!

notes.title: Major update with plenty of new features is finally out!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the program has been updated with several changes:

- All Season 1 packs have been updated to share most of the new features introduced in Season 2
- Exporting images now applies the correct color to every layer without leaving grayish tones
- Hotkeys for Save, Load, Export and to switch on all packages without going to the Settings menu
- Adding Undo and Reset functionality (with hotkeys too)
- Adding Logo category with multiple options to select from, making the logo movable
- Adding new features for Pro owners, new splash screen and extra logos to choose from
- Pro users can now remove the default bra on female characters

We've also launched our Monthly Review Raffle:

Do you like getting packs for free? All you need to do is to leave a public review on the Steam page here!
 
On the last day of each month we place everyone's name who has written a review in a virtual cap and draw 3 lucky winners who can select a pack for free to be added to their collection! Each entry participates in the raffle no matter when the review has been written, so the earlier you write it the more chances you get over time!
 
The selectable pack will include hard to get ones like the Donator Pack, or the Challenge Packs too!
 
I hope you will like the new features. Let us know your thoughts in the Discussion or on our forums.
